review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (META region / Saudi Arabia)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will be at the core of our technology stack — building, maintaining, and scaling high-availability systems that power our global services. YOUR MISSION Maintain and optimize core server infrastructure, including bare-metal servers, LXC containers, virtual machines, and cloud environments. 4+ years of experience in Linux administration, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Expertise in Kubernetes administration and managing containerized workloads.
eligibility_evidence: Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses, citizens, and support law enforcement operations.

Choose your own path: deepen your craft as a technical expert, step into leadership, move across to another team, or relocate to one of our Digital Crime Resistance Centers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East & Africa, Central Asia, and the Asia-Pacific.
A team that is genuinely international.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 4+ years of experience in Linux administration, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Strong proficiency in automating tasks using Bash or similar scripting languages. Hands-on experience managing bare-metal infrastructure in production environments. Expertise in Kubernetes administration and managing containerized workloads. Real challenges, real expertise.
